messages:
sara: FYI — opening a request: need PrivateLink/private endpoint for ACR + KeyVault in eu-west, plus NAT scaling strategy for model-serving subnets. Root account for new customer. Any blockers on quotas?

jake: Do we have the subnet CIDR plan for the new prod VNet? need to ensure /26s for model nodes and a separate /28 for private endpoints.

sara: planned ranges: 10.40.0.0/16 VNet, models 10.40.1.0/24 (then /26s inside), infra 10.40.2.0/24. Private endpoints will sit in 10.40.240.0/28. Sound ok?

nish: sounds fine, but note Azure PrivateLink requires one NIC per private endpoint and each consumes an IP — that /28 only gives 16 IPs total (13 usable). If we want >10 endpoints (ACR, KeyVault, LogAnalytics, AppGW, Redis...), bump to /27.

sara: good catch. I'll switch private endpoint subnet to /27.

maria: on NAT: we've been hitting SNAT port exhaustion on burst traffic for transformer warmups. For eu-west we should pre-provision multiple Standard NAT Gateways and attach them to different subnets or use multiple public IP prefixes. Also consider Azure NAT Gateway with idle timeout tuning.

jake: examples: attach NAT Gateway to model-serving-subnet and job-worker-subnet separately, each with 2 Public IPs. That gives more ephemeral SNAT ports.

sara: cloud-bot, can you open quota requests: 1) increase A100 family cores to 12 in eu-west (we'll use Dedicated for training spikes), 2) increase public IPs per NAT gateway to allow 4 IPs, 3) increase network interfaces per VM to 8 (some VM SKUs need more)?

cloud-bot: created request CR-98732: "Increase GPU quota A100-family to 12 in West Europe". ETA vendor reply 24-48h.

jake: also request PrivateLink service quotas: private endpoint per VNet default is 128 but some subscriptions have lower limits. Ask them to verify subscription-level endpoint limits and NIC quotas.

eng-infra-oncall: quick note — if we need predictable egress IPs for firewall rules on partner side, use NAT Gateway Standard with reserved public IP prefixes. That also makes rotation easier.

maria: cost note: additional NAT public IP prefixes + reserved prefix has monthly cost. For dev we can use dynamic IP NAT and fewer prefixes; for prod we'll reserve to keep IPs stable.

sara: agrees — reserve for prod only. For dev/staging we'll share a smaller pool.

nish: routing: remember to add a route table on the private endpoint subnet to avoid 0.0.0.0/0 routing away from endpoint. Private endpoints talk over Microsoft backbone, but misconfigured UDRs can break it.

jake: add sample az commands: ```az network vnet subnet create -g rg-prod -n pe-subnet --vnet-name vnet-prod --address-prefixes 10.40.240.0/27 --service-endpoints Microsoft.Storage Microsoft.KeyVault```

sara: thanks. Also we need to coordinate with security for NSGs: lock down private endpoint subnet to only allow AzureLoadBalancer, gateway, and required management IP ranges.

maria: ops playbook item: if NAT SNAT hits again, quick mitigation is to spin up an extra NAT Gateway with an additional public IP and attach to the subnet, then update routing — takes ~5-10min.

cloud-bot: CR-98732 updated: vendor requested justification for GPU quota. Please paste expected core-hours and projected monthly usage.

sara: pasted justification in CR-98732: "Model warmup + nightly evals -> peak 8 A100 concurrent, average 3.5 over month, projected 2k core-hours/month. Business critical for customer onboarding Q2"

jake: one more thing — ACR private endpoint: we need to enable 'network rule' exceptions or configure Pull through cache if we plan to use public image pulls. Private ACR via Private Endpoint is recommended.

sara: noted. I'll schedule a quick 15m sync tomorrow to finalize ranges and approvals. 11:00 CET?

nish: 11:00 OK for me. :thumbsup:

maria: I'll bring cost delta numbers for reserved prefixes and extra public IPs.

eng-infra-oncall: flagging potential region constraint: some subscription types can't request more than X A100s in West Europe without enrollment with partner. If CR stalls, we can propose burst to another region (north europe) temporarily.

sara: good fallback. thanks everyone.

jake: +1. I'll draft the UDR/NAT attach checklist and post it in #eng-infra later.

sara: closing loop — will update CR and post follow-up in this thread after vendor reply. :white_check_mark:
